title: 第1149章 又有后来人第1148章 激战
slug: 双修暴击十万次仙子倒贴求放过
content_zh:
段惊岳等的正是这半息。
他先前被震开的右手重新握紧枪杆，黑金甲片下渗出的血沿枪纹流入虎口。
暗红大枪得了血，枪身上的九道军纹一齐点亮。
如同一条血龙。
段惊岳结束九枪分散封路，九道枪影首尾相接，化作一杆贯穿阵台的攻城大枪。
这一枪，如同明月高悬。
枪锋直取顾平胸骨。
江观澜的六颗剑星也换了方位。
三颗封住顾平左侧，三颗钉住右侧，六道剑线在攻城大枪外织成一条狭窄剑廊。
顾平若向任何一边闪避，护住东陵小印的右臂都会先被剑线切下。
三名天骄仍在提防彼此，却已经用最短的时间补上了第一次合围的漏洞。
叶青篱握剑站在断裂的铜柱旁。
她腰侧伤口重新崩开，青衣被血黏在纤细腰线上，持剑的手却没有颤。
看见攻城大枪压得阵台中央一寸寸下沉，她踏前半步，剑锋对准了段惊岳的后颈。
“这不是你插手的地方，滚到一边去，守住你自己的命。”顾平没有回头。
叶青篱咬住发白的下唇，硬生生停在铜柱之后。
她很清楚，自己这一剑递出去，只会让顾平多救一个人。
攻城枪锋距离顾平胸口还有一丈。
前字秘在顾平识海里展开短短一瞬。
商无妄会在枪锋临身前收紧魂环，江观澜的第六颗剑星会在段惊岳右肘旁留下三寸空隙，段惊岳则在防着两人趁机卷走古印，右手的力量会比左手早到一线。

顾平抬起握印的右手，朝江观澜所在的方向一送。
东陵小印第一次离开掌心。
江观澜的瞳孔骤然收紧，六颗剑星同时向小印偏转。
商无妄也松开握拢的五指，贴地魂环拔地而起，黑暗边缘抢在剑星之前卷向古印。
只有段惊岳没有变招。
攻城大枪继续向前。
段惊岳盯着顾平的双眼，枪锋上的军城虚影越来越凝实：“想用一枚假印骗我收枪？”
“你看得准。”
顾平右手送出去的只是一团被阴阳道纹包住的暗金铜火。
真正的东陵小印仍扣在他掌根，被五指与破袖遮得严严实实。
段惊岳看破了诱饵，也替顾平撞开了魂环。
顾平眉心飞出十二根太阴噬魂刺。
冰白魂针并没有直接攻向商无妄本人，十二根魂针沿着攻城大枪轰开的裂痕，全部钉进贴地魂环的内壁。
军煞先撞乱魂环，魂针随后截断十二处魂力回路，黑色圆环当场崩开一角。
商无妄腕间的镇魂黑旗猛地结霜。
他反应极快，骨簪在掌心一转，主动斩断那一角魂环，剩余魂力收回旗内，避开了太阴寒意继续侵蚀元神。
同一刻，顾平侧身钻进攻城大枪与第六颗剑星之间的三寸空隙。
江观澜发现上当，立刻让六颗剑星倒转。
最靠近顾平的第六柄细剑横切而回，在顾平右肋贯出一道血槽。
content_en:
Duan Jingyue was waiting for this half breath.
His right hand that had been shaken away previously clenched the gun shaft again, and the blood seeping from under the black gold armor flowed into the tiger's mouth along the gun lines.
The dark red gun drew blood, and the nine military patterns on the gun's body lit up.
Like a blood dragon.
Duan Jingyue finished his nine spears and dispersed to seal the road. The nine spear shadows connected end to end and turned into a siege spear that penetrated the formation.
This shot was like the bright moon hanging high in the sky.
The spear pointed directly at Gu Ping's sternum.
Jiang Guanlan's six sword stars also changed their positions.
Three sealed Gu Ping's left side, three nailed the right, and six sword lines weaved into a narrow sword corridor outside the siege gun.
If Gu Ping dodges to any side, the right arm protecting Dongling's small seal will be cut off by the sword line first.
The three geniuses were still wary of each other, but they had already used the shortest time to make up for the loopholes in the first encirclement.
Ye Qingli stood next to the broken copper pillar holding his sword.
The wound on her waist reopened, her green clothes were stuck to her slender waistline with blood, but the hand holding the sword did not tremble.
Seeing the siege gun causing the center of the formation to sink inch by inch, she took half a step forward and aimed her sword at the back of Duan Jingyue's neck.
"This is not your place to interfere. Get out of the way and save your own life." Gu Ping did not look back.
Ye Qingli bit his white lower lip and stopped behind the copper pillar.
She knew very well that if she handed out this sword, Gu Ping would only save one more person.
The siege gun tip was still one foot away from Gu Ping's chest.
The former secretary unfolded in Gu Ping's sea of ​​consciousness for just a short moment.
Shang Wuwu would tighten his soul ring before the gun point approached, and Jiang Guanlan's sixth sword star would leave a three-inch gap next to Duan Jingyue's right elbow. Duan Jingyue was preventing the two of them from taking the opportunity to sweep away the ancient seal, and the power of his right hand would reach the edge earlier than his left hand.
Gu Ping raised his right hand holding the seal and sent it in the direction of Jiang Guanlan.
Dongling Xiaoyin left the palm for the first time.
Jiang Guanlan's pupils suddenly tightened, and the six sword stars deflected towards Xiaoyin at the same time.
Shang Wuwu also released his clasped fingers, and the soul ring rose up from the ground, and the dark edge rolled towards the ancient seal before the sword star.
Only Duan Jingyue did not change his tactics.
The siege guns continued to move forward.
Duan Jingyue stared into Gu Ping's eyes, and the shadow of the military city on the tip of the gun became more and more solid: "You want to use a fake seal to trick me into withdrawing the gun?"
"You're right."
What Gu Ping sent out with his right hand was just a ball of dark gold and copper fire wrapped in Yin and Yang Dao patterns.
The real aventurine seal was still buckled at the base of his palm, tightly covered by his fingers and torn sleeves.
Duan Jingyue saw through the bait and knocked the soul ring away for Gu Ping.
Twelve Taiyin soul-eating thorns flew out from Gu Ping's eyebrows.
The ice-white soul needles did not directly attack Shang Wuwang himself. The twelve soul needles were all driven into the inner wall of the soul ring along the cracks opened by the siege guns.
Junsha first knocked into the soul ring, and then the soul needle cut off twelve soul power circuits, and a corner of the black ring collapsed on the spot.
The soul-suppressing black flag on Shang Wuwang's wrist suddenly became frosty.
He reacted very quickly, turned the bone hairpin in his palm, and took the initiative to cut off the corner of the soul ring. The remaining soul power was withdrawn into the flag, avoiding the coldness of the lunar calendar from continuing to corrode the soul.
At the same moment, Gu Ping turned sideways and got into the three-inch gap between the attacking gun and the sixth sword star.
Jiang Guanlan discovered that he had been deceived and immediately turned the six sword stars upside down.
The sixth thin sword that was closest to Gu Ping cut across and cut a blood groove in Gu Ping's right rib.
